hero.title: Nvidia, Oracle, CoreWeave and other AI stocks sink on OpenAI revenue report
hero.description: OpenAI has told investors that it hit roughly $50 billion in annualized revenue at the end of September, CNBC confirmed.

latest.title: Wall Street's tokenization boom could have bigger winners than bitcoin and ether, Citrini says
latest.description: The research firm sees tokenized stocks, bonds and loans creating new markets for trading and lending, with fee-generating platforms and companies poised to benefit.

latest.title: Treasury yields are 'really, really high,' but can come down soon, Bessent's new adviser says
latest.description: The comments from David Zervos come after the 10-year and 30-year yields marched to 24-year highs in recent days.

latest.title: Securitize stock jumps over 10% after launching tokenized US equities on Solana
latest.description: Securitize’s new offering gives eligible investors access to tokenized shares of 12 US companies, with dividend and voting rights and plans for round-the-clock trading.

latest.title: NFL Sides With States Against Kalshi in Supreme Court Prediction Market Fight
latest.description: The NFL urged the Supreme Court to resolve a circuit split over whether states can regulate sports contracts on prediction markets, arguing they're gambling, not federally regulated swaps.

latest.title: NFL backs New Jersey authorities in SCOTUS petition over Kalshi
latest.description: According to the league, Kalshi and other prediction markets “threaten game integrity” because many event contracts are “highly susceptible to manipulation.”

latest.description: Starbucks has reportedly been working with advisers on a takeover proposal for Chipotle, but a potential deal comes with pros and cons for investors.

latest.title: U.S. suspends Microsoft, Adobe from green card labor program in foreign worker crackdown
latest.description: Labor Secretary Keith Sonderling cited "multiple active federal investigations" around the two companies' involvement in the program Thursday.

latest.title: Satoshi-Era Bitcoin Worth $8.3 Million Moves After 16 Years
latest.description: A batch of 100.02 BTC mined in July 2010 moved Wednesday after 16 years. It's worth about $8.3 million, but nothing in the transaction shows who owns it.

latest.title: Bitcoin ETFs Suffer Worst Loss Since June as Uptober Turns Red
latest.description: Investors yanked $484.9 million out of spot Bitcoin ETFs in a single day. Oil is near $100, bond yields are at their highest since 2002, and the Fed isn't done hiking.
